35	def run_case(spec: dict[str, object]) -> bool:
36	    """Run one ordinary state-study case and return its aggregate outcome."""
37	    import quimb.tensor as qtn
38	
39	    state = qtn.TN_rand_tree(
40	        n=int(spec["sites"]),
41	        D=int(spec["bond_dimension"]),
42	        phys_dim=int(spec["physical_dimension"]),
43	        max_degree=int(spec["maximum_degree"]),
44	        seed=int(spec["seed"]),
45	    )
46	    reference = state.norm()
47	    state.equalize_norms_(1.0)
48	    rescaled = state.norm()
49	
50	    gauges: dict[object, object] = {}
51	    state.gauge_all_simple_(
52	        max_iterations=int(spec["gauge_iterations"]),
53	        tol=float(spec["gauge_tolerance"]),
54	        gauges=gauges,
55	    )
56	    reconstructed = state.norm_gloop_expand(
57	        gloops=int(spec["loop_order"]),
58	        gauges={key: value.copy() for key, value in gauges.items()},
59	        autoreduce=bool(spec["autoreduce"]),
60	    )
61	
62	    values = (reference, rescaled, reconstructed)
63	    if not all(math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in values):
64	        raise ArithmeticError("state study produced a non-finite result")
65	
66	    return math.isclose(
67	        float(reference),
68	        float(reconstructed),
69	        rel_tol=float(spec["relative_tolerance"]),
70	        abs_tol=float(spec["absolute_tolerance"]),
71	    )

7	def cached_region_property(name):

25	class RegionGraph:
26	    """A graph of regions, where each region is a set of nodes. For generalized
27	    belief propagation or cluster expansion methods.
28	
29	    Parameters
30	    ----------
31	    regions : Iterable[Sequence[Hashable]]
32	        Generating regions.
33	    autocomplete : bool, optional
34	        Whether to automatically add all intersecting sub-regions, to guarantee
35	        a balanced region graph, i.e. one where each variable has an overall
36	        count of 1, with over- or under-counting.
37	    autoprune : bool, optional
38	        Whether to automatically remove all regions with a count of zero.
39	    """
40	
41	    def __init__(
42	        self,
43	        regions=(),
44	        autocomplete=True,
45	        autoprune=True,
46	    ):
47	        regions = tuple(map(frozenset, regions))
48	
49	        if not regions:
50	            self.base_nodes = frozenset()
51	        else:
52	            self.base_nodes = frozenset.intersection(*regions)
53	
54	        self.lookup = {}
55	        self.parents = {}
56	        self.children = {}
57	        self.info = {}
58	
59	        for region in regions:
60	            self.add_region(region)
61	        if autocomplete:
62	            self.autocomplete()
63	        if autoprune:
64	            self.autoprune()
65	
66	    def reset_info(self):
67	        """Remove all cached region properties."""
68	        self.info.clear()
69	
70	    @property
71	    def regions(self):
72	        """Return a tuple of all regions in the graph."""
73	        return tuple(self.children)
74	
75	    def get_maximal_regions(self):
76	        """Get all maximal regions, i.e. those with no parents."""
77	        return {r for r in self.regions if not self.parents[r]}
78	
79	    def get_minimal_regions(self):
80	        """Get all minimal regions, i.e. those with no children."""
81	        return {r for r in self.regions if not self.children[r]}
82	
83	    def get_overlapping(self, region):
84	        """Get all regions that intersect with the given region."""
85	        region = frozenset(region)
86	
87	        if self.base_nodes:
88	            # all regions are overlapping
89	            return {
90	                other_region
91	                for other_region in self.regions
92	                if other_region != region
93	            }
94	        else:
95	            return {
96	                other_region
97	                for node in region
98	                for other_region in self.lookup[node]
99	                if other_region != region
100	            }

102	    def add_region(self, region):
103	        """Add a new region and update parent-child relationships.
104	
105	        Parameters
106	        ----------
107	        region : Sequence[Hashable]
108	            The new region to add.
109	        """
110	        region = frozenset(region)
111	
112	        if region in self.parents:
113	            # already added
114	            return
115	
116	        # populate data structures
117	        self.parents[region] = set()
118	        self.children[region] = set()
119	        for node in region:
120	            # collect regions that contain nodes for fast neighbor lookup
121	            self.lookup.setdefault(node, set()).add(region)
122	
123	        # add parent-child relationships
124	        for other in self.get_overlapping(region):
125	            if region.issubset(other):
126	                self.parents[region].add(other)
127	                self.children[other].add(region)
128	            elif other.issubset(region):
129	                self.children[region].add(other)
130	                self.parents[other].add(region)
131	
132	        # prune redundant parents and children
133	        children = sorted(self.children[region], key=len)
134	        for i, c in enumerate(children):
135	            if any(c.issubset(cc) for cc in children[i + 1 :]):
136	                # child is a subset of larger child -> remove
137	                self.children[region].remove(c)
138	                self.parents[c].remove(region)
139	
140	        parents = sorted(self.parents[region], key=len, reverse=True)
141	        for i, p in enumerate(parents):
142	            if any(p.issuperset(pp) for pp in parents[i + 1 :]):
143	                # parent is a superset of smaller parent -> remove
144	                self.parents[region].remove(p)
145	                self.children[p].remove(region)
146	
147	            for c in self.children[region]:
148	                if p.issuperset(c):
149	                    # parent is a superset of child -> ensure no link
150	                    self.parents[c].discard(p)
151	                    self.children[p].discard(c)
152	
153	        self.reset_info()
154	
155	    def remove_region(self, region):
156	        """Remove a region and update parent-child relationships."""
157	        # remove from lookup
158	        for node in region:
159	            self.lookup[node].remove(region)
160	
161	        # remove from parents and children, joining those up
162	        parents = self.parents.pop(region)
163	        children = self.children.pop(region)
164	        for p in parents:
165	            self.children[p].remove(region)
166	            self.children[p].update(children)
167	        for c in children:
168	            self.parents[c].remove(region)
169	            self.parents[c].update(parents)
170	
171	        self.reset_info()

173	    def autocomplete(self):
174	        """Add all missing intersecting sub-regions."""
175	        if self.base_nodes:
176	            # all regions are overlapping
177	            rs = self.regions
178	            for i in range(len(rs)):
179	                for j in range(i + 1, len(rs)):
180	                    self.add_region(rs[i] & rs[j])
181	        else:
182	            for r in self.regions:
183	                for other in self.get_overlapping(r):
184	                    self.add_region(r & other)

186	    def autoprune(self):
187	        """Remove all regions with a count of zero."""
188	        for r in self.regions:
189	            if self.get_count(r) == 0:
190	                self.remove_region(r)

192	    def autoextend(self, regions=None):
193	        """Extend this region graph upwards by adding in all pairwise unions of
194	        regions. If regions is specified, take this as one set of pairs.
195	        """
196	        if regions is None:
197	            regions = self.regions
198	
199	        neighbors = {}
200	        for r in regions:
201	            for other in self.get_overlapping(r):
202	                neighbors.setdefault(r, []).append(other)
203	
204	        for r, others in neighbors.items():
205	            for other in others:
206	                self.add_region(r | other)

208	    def get_parents(self, region):
209	        """Get all ancestors that contain the given region, but do not contain
210	        any other regions that themselves contain the given region.
211	        """
212	        return self.parents[region]

214	    def get_children(self, region):
215	        """Get all regions that are contained by the given region, but are not
216	        contained by any other descendents of the given region.

220	    @cached_region_property("ancestors")
221	    def get_ancestors(self, region):
222	        """Get all regions that contain the given region, not just direct
223	        parents.
224	        """
225	        seen = set()
226	        queue = [region]
227	        while queue:
228	            r = queue.pop()
229	            for rp in self.parents[r]:
230	                if rp not in seen:
231	                    seen.add(rp)
232	                    queue.append(rp)
233	        return seen

235	    @cached_region_property("maximal_ancestors")
236	    def get_maximal_ancestors(self, region):
237	        """Get all maximal regions (top level regions not contained in any
238	        other region) that contain the given region.
239	        """
240	        return {r for r in self.get_ancestors(region) if not self.parents[r]}
241	
242	    @cached_region_property("descendents")
243	    def get_descendents(self, region):
244	        """Get all regions that are contained by the given region, not just
245	        direct children.
246	        """
247	        seen = set()
248	        queue = [region]
249	        while queue:
250	            r = queue.pop()
251	            for rc in self.children[r]:
252	                if rc not in seen:
253	                    seen.add(rc)
254	                    queue.append(rc)
255	        return seen

257	    @cached_region_property("coparent_pairs")
258	    def get_coparent_pairs(self, region):
259	        """Get all regions which are direct parents of any descendant of the
260	        given region, but not themselves descendants of the given region.
261	        """
262	        # start with direct parents
263	        coparent_pairs = [(p, region) for p in self.get_parents(region)]
264	
265	        # get all descendents
266	        rds = self.get_descendents(region)
267	
268	        # exclude the region and its descendents
269	        seen = {region, *rds}
270	
271	        # for each descendant
272	        for rd in rds:
273	            # add only its parents...
274	            for rdp in self.get_parents(rd):
275	                # ... which are not themselves descendents
276	                if rdp not in seen:
277	                    coparent_pairs.append((rdp, rd))
278	                    seen.add(rdp)
279	
280	        return coparent_pairs

282	    @cached_region_property("count")
283	    def get_count(self, region):
284	        """Get the count of the given region, i.e. the correct weighting to
285	        apply when summing over all regions to avoid overcounting.
286	        """
287	        return 1 - sum(self.get_count(a) for a in self.get_ancestors(region))

289	    def get_total_count(self):
290	        """Get the total count of all regions. For a region graph to be
291	        'totally balanced', this should equal 1.
292	        """
293	        return sum(map(self.get_count, self.regions))

296	    def get_level(self, region):
297	        """Get the level of the given region, i.e. the distance to an ancestor
298	        with no parents.
299	        """
300	        if not self.parents[region]:
301	            return 0
302	        else:
303	            return min(self.get_level(p) for p in self.get_parents(region)) - 1

305	    @cached_region_property("message_parts")
306	    def get_message_parts(self, pair):
307	        """Get the three contribution groups for a GBP message from region
308	        `source` to region `target`. 1. The part of region `source` that is
309	        not part of target, i.e. the factors to include. 2. The messages that
310	        appear in the numerator of the update equation. 3. The messages that
311	        appear in the denominator of the update equation.
312	
313	        Parameters
314	        ----------
315	        source : Region
316	            The source region, should be a parent of `target`.
317	        target : Region
318	            The target region, should be a child of `source`.
319	
320	        Returns
321	        -------
322	        factors : Region
323	            The difference of `source` and `target`, which will include the
324	            factors to appear in the numerator of the update equation.
325	        pairs_mul : set[(Region, Region)]
326	            The messages that appear in the numerator of the update equation,
327	            after cancelling out those that appear in the denominator.
328	        pairs_div : set[(Region, Region)]
329	            The messages that appear in the denominator of the update equation,
330	            after cancelling out those that appear in the numerator.
331	        """
332	        source, target = pair
333	        factors = source - target
334	
335	        # we want to cancel out messages that appear in both of:
336	        # the messages that go into the belief of region `source`
337	        source_pairs = set(self.get_coparent_pairs(source))
338	        # the messages that go into the belief of region `target`
339	        target_pairs = set(self.get_coparent_pairs(target))
340	        # the current message to be updated by defn appears directly in the
341	        # update numerator, but also target belief region, so can be cancelled
342	        target_pairs.remove((source, target))
343	
344	        pairs_mul = source_pairs - target_pairs
345	        pairs_div = target_pairs - source_pairs
346	
347	        return factors, pairs_mul, pairs_div

350	        """Check if the region graph is balanced, i.e. each variable has an
351	        overall count of 1.
352	        """
353	        counts = {}
354	        for r in self.regions:

367	        """Run some basic consistency checks on the region graph."""
368	        for r, rps in self.parents.items():
369	            for rp in rps:
370	                assert r.issubset(rp)
371	                assert r in self.get_children(rp)

374	            for rd in self.get_descendents(r):
375	                assert r.issuperset(rd)
376	                assert r in self.get_ancestors(rd)
377	
378	            for ra in self.get_ancestors(r):
379	                assert r.issubset(ra)
380	                assert r in self.get_descendents(ra)
381	
382	            rps = self.get_parents(r)

384	                assert not rpa.issubset(rpb)
385	                assert not rpb.issubset(rpa)
386	
387	            rcs = self.get_children(r)
388	            for rca, rcb in itertools.combinations(rcs, 2):
389	                assert not rca.issubset(rcb)
390	                assert not rcb.issubset(rca)

447	def trie_add(trie, region):
448	    """Add a region to a trie data structure. This will create a nested
449	    dictionary structure where each node in the region corresponds to a
450	    key in the dictionary. The final leaf node will have a special key
451	    "__leaf__" that contains the original region.
452	    """
453	    try:
454	        canonical_ordered = sorted(region)
455	    except TypeError:
456	        canonical_ordered = sorted(region, key=repr)
457	
458	    t = trie
459	    for node in canonical_ordered:
460	        t = t.setdefault(node, {})
461	    t["__leaf__"] = region

464	def trie_gen_subsets(trie, region):
465	    """Given a trie of regions, lazily generate all strict subsets
466	    (descendants) of the given region.
467	    """
468	    regionset = set(region)
469	    queue = [trie]
470	    while queue:
471	        t = queue.pop()
472	        rsub = t.get("__leaf__", None)
473	        if rsub is not None and rsub != region:
474	            yield rsub
475	        queue.extend(t for node, t in t.items() if node in regionset)

478	def gen_region_counts(regions, autocomplete=True, autoprune=True):
479	    """Lazily generate all intersecting regions and their counts. This is
480	    faster that constructing the full RegionGraph, using a trie to get
481	    all subsets (descendants) of each region.
482	
483	    Parameters
484	    ----------
485	    regions : Iterable[Sequence[Hashable]]
486	        Generating regions.
487	    autocomplete : bool, optional
488	        Whether to automatically add all intersecting sub-regions, to guarantee
489	        a complete region graph.
490	    autoprune : bool, optional
491	        Whether to automatically remove all regions with a count of zero.
492	        Default is True.
493	
494	    Yields
495	    ------
496	    region : frozenset
497	        The region for which the count is being calculated.
498	    count : int
499	        The count of the region, which is the correct weighting to apply when
500	        summing over all regions to avoid overcounting.
501	    """
502	    # remove redundant nodes that appear in all regions
503	    # (we just re-add these when yielding)
504	    regions = tuple(map(frozenset, regions))
505	
506	    if not regions:
507	        return
508	
509	    base_region = frozenset.intersection(*regions)
510	    if base_region:
511	        regions = tuple(r - base_region for r in regions)
512	
513	    counts = {}
514	    # for intersections
515	    lookup = {}
516	    # for subsets
517	    trie = {}
518	
519	    for ri in regions:
520	        counts[ri] = 0
521	        trie_add(trie, ri)
522	
523	        if autocomplete:
524	            # simultenously get previous overlapping regions ...
525	            rjs = set()
526	            for node in ri:
527	                others = lookup.setdefault(node, [])
528	                for rj in others:
529	                    rjs.add(rj)
530	                # ... as well as then inserting current region
531	                others.append(ri)

import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=spec["sites"], D=spec["bond_dimension"],
                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
Z0 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z1 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
info = {}
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges, info=info)
print("iters:", info["iterations"], "max_sdiff:", info["max_sdiff"])

# check 1: gauge-representation invariance: insert gauges on a fresh copy,
# contract ket with ket inserted (both same representation) -> should equal Z1
kg = psi.copy()
kg.gauge_simple_insert(gauges)
# contract kg.H | kg using NON-virtual & to avoid the rename mutation
Zg = float((kg.H & kg).contract(all))
print("gauge invariance: Z1 =", Z1, " Zg =", Zg, " reldiff =", abs(Zg - Z1) / abs(Z1))
# note & copies; H conj copy; fine

# check 2: per-site fixed point relation:
# V_i[b] = sum over all legs except bond b of |t'_i|^2  (stored tensors)
print("\nsite  bond-dims   V_i[g]*(g)^2 / g / const check")
tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()
for tid, t in sorted(psi.tensor_map.items()):
    site = tid2site[tid]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    rows = []
    for ix in bonds:
        others = [x for x in t.inds if x != ix]
        tc = t.copy()
        tc.reindex_({x: x + "'" for x in others})
        M = (t.H.reindex({x: x + "'" for x in others}) @ tc).data
        offdiag = np.abs(M - np.diag(np.diag(M))).max()
        V = np.diag(M)
        g = gauges[ix]
        rows.append((ix, offdiag, V, g))
    cands = {}
    for ix, offdiag, V, g in rows:
        cands["V*g^2"] = cands.get("V*g^2", []) + [(V * g**2).min(), (V * g**2).max()]
        cands["V*g"] = cands.get("V*g", []) + [(V * g).min(), (V * g).max()]
        cands["V"] = cands.get("V", []) + [V.min(), V.max()]
    print(
        f"site {site}: offdiag_max={max(r[1] for r in rows):.2e} "
        + " ".join(f"{k}:[{min(v[::2]):.3e},{max(v[1::2]):.3e}]" for k, v in cands.items())
    )

# check 3: telescoping for full tree with exact contraction using
# normalized-gauge representation: normalize gauges, insert, contract
g2 = {k: v / np.linalg.norm(v) for k, v in gauges.items()}
kg2 = psi.copy()
kg2.gauge_simple_insert(g2)
Zg2 = float((kg2.H & kg2).contract(all))
print("\nZ with normalized gauges inserted:", Zg2, " (compare Z1 =", Z1, ")")

import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=spec["sites"], D=spec["bond_dimension"],
                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z1 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges)

# For each bond b of each site i: build environment matrix
#   E_i[k,k'] = sum_{rest} t̂[i] * conj(t̂'[i])
# where t̂ has FULL gauge g inserted on every OTHER incident bond leg.
tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()

for tid in sorted(psi.tensor_map, key=lambda x: tid2site[x]):
    t = psi.tensor_map[tid]
    site = tid2site[tid]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    for ix in bonds:
        others = [x for x in bonds if x != ix]
        tg = t.copy()
        for ox in others:
            tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ox, gauges[ox])
        bra = tg.H.reindex({ix: ix + "'"})
        E = (bra @ tg).data  # (ix', ix)
        diag = np.real(np.diag(E))
        off = np.abs(E - np.diag(np.diag(E))).max()
        g = gauges[ix]
        # candidate relations
        c1 = diag * g**2
        c2 = diag / g**2
        c3 = diag * g
        c4 = diag / g
        print(
            f"site {site} ix={ix}: offmax={off:.2e} "
            f"E*g^2 spread=[{c1.min():.3e},{c1.max():.3e}] "
            f"E/g^2 spread=[{c2.min():.3e},{c2.max():.3e}] "
            f"E*g spread=[{c3.min():.3e},{c3.max():.3e}] "
            f"E/g spread=[{c4.min():.3e},{c4.max():.3e}]"
        )

# telescoping check for the 2-site subnetwork? verify full-tree identity:
# Z (gauges normalized first) vs prod lnorm
g2 = {k: (v / np.linalg.norm(v)).copy() for k, v in gauges.items()}
kg = psi.copy()
kg.gauge_simple_insert(g2)
Zg_norm = float((kg.H & kg).contract(all))

    lnorm = float((tsg.H & tsg).contract(all)) ** 0.5

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)

                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],

psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z1 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}

tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()
print("per (site,bond) E_s diagonal entries (E_s frame = full g on OTHER legs):")
for tid in sorted(psi.tensor_map, key=lambda x: tid2site[x]):
    t = psi.tensor_map[tid]
    site = tid2site[tid]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    for ix in bonds:
        others = [x for x in bonds if x != ix]
        tg = t.copy()
        for ox in others:
            tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ox, gauges[ox])
        bra = tg.H.reindex({ix: ix + "'"})

              f"scalarI={np.abs(diag - diag[0]).max():.2e}")

for ix, g in gauges.items():
    print(f"  bond {ix[-5:]}: ||g||={np.linalg.norm(g):.6e} entries={np.array2string(g, precision=4)}")

# eliminate leaf subtrees: message from site i to neighbor j over bond b:
# m_{i->j}[k] = sum_rest |t_i|^2 prod_{other legs} m_{n->i}, then normalize
sites = sorted(psi.sites)
adj = {s: [] for s in sites}
for (a, b), ix in bonds:
    adj[a].append((b, ix))
    adj[b].append((a, ix))


def get_msg(i, j, ix, msgs):
    t = psi[psi.site_tag(i)]
    legs = [x for x in t.inds if x != psi.site_ind(i)]
    other = [(x, n) for (n, x) in adj[i] if n != j]
    tn = (t.H.reindex({x: x + "'" for x in legs}) | t)
    for x, n in other:
        m = msgs[n, i]
        tn.multiply_index_diagonal_(x, m)
        tn.multiply_index_diagonal_(x + "'", m)
    out = tn.contract_inds(
        [x for x in t.inds if x != ix] + [x + "'" for x in legs if x != ix]
    )
    v = np.diag(out.data).real

# iterate to convergence

for s, nbrs in adj.items():

    for s, nbrs in adj.items():

            new[s, n] = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    diff = max(np.linalg.norm(new[s, n] - msgs[s, n]) for s, n in msgs)
    msgs = new

    print("   sqrt(m_ij*m_ji):", np.array2string(np.sqrt(m_ij * m_ji) / np.linalg.norm(np.sqrt(m_ij * m_ji)), precision=6))

for seed, n, D, deg in [(11, 3, 2, 2), (3, 4, 2, 2), (123, 9, 3, 3), (271, 11, 2, 3)]:
    psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=n, D=D, phys_dim=2, max_degree=deg, seed=seed)
    ref_norm = float(psi.norm())

    E = psi.exponent

    nfactor = psic.normalize_simple(gg)
